title: security: rbac v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policies, emit kms_key_id and kms_region in audit logs, add migration path and admin toggle. No user-facing API changes; may change admin policy validation behavior.
description:
Motivation: Compliance customers require that resources encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS) be restricted to specific regions and that policy decisions surface the KMS residency as part of audit logs. This PR updates RBAC v2 policy validation and enforcement to support KMS region pinning, improves audit log events to include kms_key_id and kms_region, and adds a lightweight migration and admin guard for rolling the change out.

Summary of changes: 
- Add `kms_residency` constraint to RBAC v2 policy schema and enforcement checks.
- Emit `kms_key_id` and `kms_region` on relevant audit events (resource.create, resource.update, inference.request) when a customer-managed key is used.
- Add a feature-flagged validation path: `rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning` (off by default for gradual rollout).
- Provide a migration utility to scan existing policies and surface violations in the admin console.
- Unit + integration tests for policy validation and audit payloads.
- Docs updates and changelog entry.

Checklist:
- [x] Spec and design doc (Linear ENG-8421) linked
- [x] Schema + validation implementation
- [x] Audit event changes and test coverage
- [x] Migration tool + admin UI flag
- [x] E2E on staging with customer toggles
- [x] Docs and changelog updated

Backward compatibility: Policy schema extends with an optional `kms_residency` field. If the enforcement flag is off, validation is advisory only. When turned on, misconfigured policies will be rejected; operators must run the migration tool first.

Related: Linear ENG-8421, SEC-102, support ticket SUP-4482 (customer asking for enforced KMS residency for EU keys).
